annotations.title: Technical indicators, RSI, MACD: moving averages, Bollinger bands and ATR for crypto

description: Technical indicators for a Hyperliquid perpetual (BTC, ETH, SOL…) on closed candles of any interval from 1m to 1w: RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, SMA 20/50/200, EMA 12/26/50, Bollinger bands 20/2 with %B, ATR 14, annualised realised volatility, and plain readings such as overbought or above the 200 SMA. Computed from Hyperliquid's public candles. Use as context for a trading agent or a market dashboard; not investment advice. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
